records.context: ``None`` hands the raw selected image layers to Cellpose and skips post-processing entirely. Any key-value mapping, ``{}`` included, switches on both :func:`spacr.io._normalize_img_batch` and :func:`spacr.object.merge_split_filter_masks`. The four ``*_channel`` role structured-data names are rewritten on a copy (the caller's key-value mapping is left alone): all cleared to None, then ``object_type`` set to 0, plus ``nucleus_channel=1`` when ``object_type`` is ``"cell"`` and two or more image layers were selected. An explicit ``unmix_calibration`` with ``unmix`` selects the organized 2D calibrated cell route: signed valid-ROI extracted image regions are retained separately, segmentation uses a nonnegative view and labels are restored to the original reference canvas with incomplete boundary objects removed. Unsupported preprocessing, custom/intensity/ perimeter filters and quality exclusion refuse before inference. Optional ``unmix_per_plate`` selects complete physical-image data channel controls from a JSON master map for one exact source plate/time/image layer; mixed sources and missing assignments refuse before output creation.
records.label: spacr.pipeline_v2.run_v2#16
records.source: ``None`` hands the raw selected planes to Cellpose and skips post-processing entirely. Any dict, ``{}`` included, switches on both :func:`spacr.io._normalize_img_batch` and :func:`spacr.object.merge_split_filter_masks`. The four ``*_channel`` role keys are rewritten on a copy (the caller's dict is left alone): all cleared to None, then ``object_type`` set to 0, plus ``nucleus_channel=1`` when ``object_type`` is ``"cell"`` and two or more planes were selected. An explicit ``unmix_calibration`` with ``unmix`` selects the organized 2D calibrated cell route: signed valid-ROI crops are retained separately, segmentation uses a nonnegative view and labels are restored to the original reference canvas with incomplete boundary objects removed. Unsupported preprocessing, custom/intensity/ perimeter filters and quality exclusion refuse before inference. Optional ``unmix_per_plate`` selects complete physical-channel controls from a JSON master map for one exact source plate/time/plane; mixed sources and missing assignments refuse before output creation.
records.translation: ``None`` entrega los planos originales seleccionados a Cellpose y omite todo el posprocesamiento. Cualquier dict, incluido ``{}``, activa tanto :func:`spacr.io._normalize_img_batch` como :func:`spacr.object.merge_split_filter_masks`. Las cuatro claves de función ``*_channel`` se reescriben en una copia (el dict del llamante no cambia): primero se ponen todas en None, después ``object_type`` se fija en 0, y además ``nucleus_channel=1`` cuando ``object_type`` es ``"cell"`` y se han seleccionado dos o más planos. Un ``unmix_calibration`` explícito junto con ``unmix`` selecciona la ruta celular 2D organizada y calibrada: los recortes con signo del ROI válido se conservan por separado, la segmentación utiliza una vista no negativa y las etiquetas se restituyen al lienzo de referencia original, eliminando objetos incompletos del borde. El preprocesamiento no admitido, los filtros personalizados, de intensidad o de perímetro y la exclusión por calidad se rechazan antes de la inferencia. El ``unmix_per_plate`` opcional selecciona controles completos de canales físicos a partir de un mapa maestro JSON para una placa/tiempo/plano de origen exactos; las fuentes mixtas y las asignaciones ausentes se rechazan antes de crear la salida.

records.source: Explicit custom collators retain their existing behavior. Single-process loaders use ordinary PyTorch collation and iteration unchanged. Use NumPy transport only for worker loaders without a custom collator.
records.translation: Los colacionadores personalizados explícitos conservan su comportamiento existente. Los cargadores de un solo proceso utilizan la colación e iteración habituales de PyTorch sin cambios. Utiliza el transporte NumPy solo para cargadores de trabajadores sin un colacionador personalizado.
